info.name: HustleHub Part 2 - Rate Limit Demo
info.description:
Run with: newman run <this file> -n 35 --insecure

Sends repeated failed logins. The login limiter allows 30 requests per 15 minutes per IP, then returns 429 with a clear message. Run this LAST (or restart the server afterwards), because it locks login/register for 15 minutes.

exec: pm.test("Request is either rejected (401) or rate limited (429)", () => pm.expect([401, 429]).to.include(code));
pm.test("RateLimit headers tell the client the limit and remaining requests", () => {
pm.test("429 response has a meaningful message", () =>
pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Too many authentication attempts. Try again later."));
pm.test("Login was rate limited after too many attempts", () => pm.expect(pm.collectionVariables.get("limited")).to.eql("yes"));
